name: Ch’ien Wei-yen
bio: Ch’ien Wei-yen (錢惟演; Qian Weiyan; 977–1034) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 木兰花・玉楼春 (Mu lan hua / Yu lou chun)
poems.author: Ch’ien Wei-yen
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
城上风光莺语乱。
城下烟波春拍岸。
绿杨芳草几时休，泪眼愁肠先已断。
情怀渐变成衰晚。
鸾鉴朱颜惊暗换。
昔年多病厌芳尊，今日芳尊惟恐浅。
